extraction.document_summary: AIA Pay Protector is an AIA Singapore disability income insurance plan designed to provide fixed monthly income payouts when disability disrupts employment. The brochure states it pays a fixed monthly income for up to 5 years to help supplement loss of earnings, and it highlights that the monthly payout is not reduced by earnings or future changes to income. There is a 90-day deferment period mentioned in the benefits-at-a-glance section, and premiums are waived during the monthly income payout period (or until recovery, whichever is earlier). The plan is linked with AIA Vitality for premium discounts of up to 15% (capped at 15%, eligible from the second policy year onwards and only for members aged 16+), though the discount is not applied to loading-related extra premiums. An example illustrates that a S$3,000 monthly payout could total S$180,000 over 60 months.
quality_notes: The document is largely marketing/illustration content; core contractual details such as exact definitions of covered disability and explicit exclusion lists are not provided.
It mentions 'Choice of five affordable plans' but does not list the five plan names/tiers or the full set of coverage options.
Only one explicit coverage amount (S$1,000 monthly income payout) has premium rates shown (for 30-year-old non-smoker, occupational class 1), and higher payout plan options are not enumerated.

policies.quick_summary:
Disability income insurance paying fixed monthly income for up to 5 years with a 90-day deferment period, and premium waivers during payout/recovery; AIA Vitality may provide up to 15% premium discounts (capped) from the second policy year for eligible members (not applied to loading-related extra premiums). Coverage is described as applicable even for temporary/less severe disabilities and mental illnesses, but formal definitions/exclusions are not included in the brochure text provided here.

Stated example: S$3,000 monthly income payout for up to 5 years (S$3,000 x 60 months = S$180,000). Premium example provided for S$1,000 monthly income payout: S$18/month (30-year-old male) and S$26/month (30-year-old female), for non-smoker, occupational class 1.
policies.target_customer: Not stated (brochure uses examples for working adults employed in specified roles).
coverage_scope: Disability income for temporary or less severe disabilities and mental illnesses (as described in brochure marketing text)
Fixed monthly income payouts for up to 5 years
policies.eligibility_notes: AIA Vitality discount eligibility depends on AIA Vitality Status and is only eligible for members aged 16 and above (discount capped at 15%; not applicable to any extra premiums due to loading).
policies.coverage_term_description: Monthly income payouts are stated as payable for up to 5 years; brochure also states 'income till age 65' in the narrative example.
policy_termination_events: Termination according to the free-look provision (described generally)
important_caveats: Brochure states that the precise terms and conditions including exclusions are specified in the policy contract, which is not included here.
AIA Vitality discount is only applicable to premiums based on a standard life and is not applicable to extra premiums due to loading.
Premium rates shown are for a 30-year-old non-smoker, occupational class 1 and rounded to the nearest dollar.
